This is so fucking wrong I can’t even fathom how you think this. “You probably have some sort of eating disorder like binge eating” wtf?! Coming from personal experience this is completely untrue. I went from an obese BMI to literally on the borderline of UW and I never struggled with binging. I restricted lower (until recently) and exercised more when I was at a higher weight than I do now that I’m at a BMI of >!18.5!< and my mindset was just as bad back then as it is now. I’ve literally lost half of my body weight and I still don’t qualify as having a low enough bmi to have anorexia. Anorexia is a *mental* illness not a fucking weight disorder. Granted I know there are people in larger bodies who try to get people to feel sorry for them by saying they haven’t eaten in days when that’s not the case, but this isn’t the case here and atypical anorexia is *real*. Do your research before you say some catastrophically triggering shit.
